name: skribbil
description: a cross-game community league powered by scribble.rs

paragraphs: The Clubhouse is our community home: shared profiles, private friend groups, clans, tournaments, and admin-created leagues. Skribbil is its first game, with the original scribble.rs drawing game. The familiar canvas, guesses, rounds, and real-time rooms still run on its Go engine. Accounts and community identity are shared foundations for future games; only Skribbil is playable today. Open Play to create a room or paste an invite code; open Clubhouses for invite-only groups. Saved avatars appear beside players' ranks and scores inside the game.

Make your permanent avatar in the Character Workshop. Before a managed game, Edit room look gives you a temporary name and preset character just for that match. Your profile stays unchanged; guests ready up and the host starts the game.
Live casual preview · Free hosting · Ranked disabled
features: Make it yours: profiles, cropped photo avatars, admin-assigned titles and frames, match
Set the mood: quieter pop effects, saved sound volume, and a one-click mute.
Play together: configurable private rooms, spectators, friends, parties,
Keep the good doodles: automatic archives, artist-controlled publication
